FAQ

What currency is accept?

AUD : Australia Dollar (AUD).

How to create an account?

Click the "REGISTER" button on the homepage to register. After successful registration, Click the "DEPOSIT" button to top up and click the "WITHDRAW" button to withdraw money.

Can I register multiple accounts?

No, we strictly prohibit the registration of multiple accounts. If the rules are violated, the account will be restricted, and many benefits will be forfeited.

What are the deposit and withdrawal limits?

  1. The minimum deposit is AUD 10
  2. The minimum withdrawal is AUD 30 (Does not include the applied bonus)
  • Deposit of any amount requires Rollover x1 (Total Bet)
  • Withdrawals are limited to 5 times a day
  • Max Withdraw = Deposit Amount x 150 Times
  • Example: Deposit AUD 30, Max Withdraw = AUD 4500. Deposit AUD 100, Max Withdraw = AUD 15000
  • Max Payout for All Pokies Games AUD 100000

When Must I Withdraw My Winnings

✅ Yes.

Players are required to withdraw all gameplay winnings within 7 days of receiving them.

⏳ If no withdrawal is made within this period, the winnings will be automatically forfeited by the system.

Deposit balances may be kept in the wallet without any time limit.

However, storing game play winnings for extended periods and requesting withdrawal later is not permitted.

⚠️ To avoid any potential loss, we strongly recommend withdrawing winnings without delay.

Can I top up if I still have balance?

In order to avoid confusion with the bonus rules, you must play and bet your credit after each deposit. Once your credit drop below AUD 1 or after a withdrawal, you will be able to submit another deposit.

What is ROLLOVER and TURNOVER?

Different companies have different abbreviations and rules, but at ALL117, we only use rollover and turnover, as outlined in the following instructions.

ROLLOVER : Total bet in game

TURNOVER : Minimum withdraw / Final remain credit

Can I claim different bonus at the same time?

No, you cannot apply for multiple promotions, bonuses, rebates, or commissions at the same time

Although you may sometimes click on multiple bonuses, this will combine the withdrawal rules for different bonuses. Violating the rules will result in forfeiting the bonuses.

Why do games platforms sometimes disappear?

For a better gaming experience, some game platforms may undergo maintenance from time to time

During the maintenance period, the platform will be temporarily removed from the website and will be reinstated once the maintenance is complete.

I have met the Rollover requirements, Why can't I withdraw money?

Depositing and applying for a bonus will have rollover requirements. Once you complete the rollover requirements, please exit the game completely and allow the system some time to update the rollover progress bar.

Once the rollover progress bar is full, you can proceed with withdrawals.

Can I change my bank account?

In order to protect both of our bank accounts, we are strict about allowing customers to change their bank account. Unless your registered account is frozen or blocked, we will verify the authenticity of the situation and request supporting documents.

What should I do if I cannot receive the verification code?

To register a new user or reset a forgotten password, you will need to request a verification code. However, sometimes the verification code may not be received.

For security reasons, users cannot ask for the code directly in Live Chat. After contacting our customer service, we will provide two methods to verify the authenticity of the membership number.

Can customer service create an account for me?

No. For user authenticity, you must register and accept the mobile phone verification code. Please click the 'REGISTER' button on the homepage to complete your registration.
